text:
emma: Quick question from Acme onboarding — they returned the vendor risk form asking whether embeddings are stored long-term and how to delete them. can we confirm our behavior and a short line I can paste into the form? :thinking_face:

ops-bot: Shared doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/embeddings-data-retention (access: redwood/cs) :link:

raj: Short answer: we persist embedding vectors for tenant-scoped features and caching, retention depends on plan + contract. For Hosted accounts default is 90 days, Dedicated can be configured, Private is customer-controlled.

marta: Legal suggestion: avoid 'delete immediately' phrasing. use: "Embeddings derived from your data are retained per contract; we support deletion requests and can expunge vectors within our retention window subject to backups and audit processes."

emma: perfect. can someone confirm the API call to request deletion? customer asked for a one-line instruction they can follow.

liam: For Hosted: submit a ticket via support portal or call the Data Deletion endpoint. Example curl: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/:tenant_id/data-delete 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' 
 -d '{"scope":"embeddings","from":"2024-01-01","reason":"customer_request"}'
``` Note: this triggers workflow; full purge may take up to 72 hours due to async jobs and backups.

emma: can we add the 72h note in the form reply. also they asked if deleting embeddings affects model fine-tuning jobs.

raj: Deleting embeddings does not retroactively remove weights from any model fine-tunes done on customer-supplied training corpora — we do not fine-tune hosted models on customer data. If customer used our Dedicated/private training service, we need to check contract and training logs.

marta: Add: "We do not use embeddings to retrain public/shared models; for Dedicated/Private, training is controlled by contract and documented in the training report."

emma: ok draft reply I'm about to send (please DM edits): "We retain embeddings per your contract; for Hosted accounts default retention is 90 days. You can request deletion via our support portal or the Data Deletion API (example curl below). Deletion workflows are asynchronous and may take up to 72 hours to fully expunge vectors from live indexes; backups may require additional time and are handled per contract. We do not use embeddings to retrain public/shared models."

liam: LGTM, maybe add support ticket link: https://support.redwood.ai/requests/new

emma: added. thanks all — sending now. :rocket:

raj: one last note — for high-risk customers we should offer an evidence artifact showing deletion job run id and timestamp. i'll follow up with a short template we can attach.

emma: great, please drop the template here when ready.

ops-bot: Reminder: create CS follow-up task: /task create "Acme - confirm embedding deletion" due: +3d assignee: @emma

emma: noted, will pick up the artifact when raj posts it.

marta: FYI i've updated the standard DPA FAQ with the recommended language so other reps can copy it.

emma: thanks everyone, closing the thread. :white_check_mark:
